Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the lineage despite the sourced page stating that William de Beauchamp (Richard’s father) was the fourth son of Thomas de Beauchamp, 11th Earl of Warwick. Therefore, Richard’s paternal grandfather is Thomas de Beauchamp, not Guy de Beauchamp. The Planner conflated generations (jumping to the great-grandfather) by “aligning via the uncle” and prematurely finalized the answer without proper verification, leading to the generational/ordinal error.
